Communication App for Autistic Adults | Tonen

# A communication app for autistic adults

Conversations can be complex and unpredictable. Tonen helps autistic adults prepare for real-life conversations with ready-to-use scripts, tone options and private practice.

## Communication can feel harder when expectations are unclear

Many autistic adults describe conversations as one of the most challenging parts of everyday life. It can be difficult to know what someone expects, how something might sound to another person or what words to use in a stressful moment.

Tonen provides practical support for navigating these situations, helping you prepare for conversations and feel more confident about what to say.

### Preparing for conversations

Plan what to say before a meeting, conversation or message.

### Understanding tone

Explore different ways to phrase something so it sounds clearer.

### Setting boundaries

Find words that help you explain your needs or limits.

### Navigating work communication

Prepare for workplace conversations like asking for help or clarifying tasks.

### Declining invitations politely

Find comfortable ways to say no to social plans.

### Ready-to-use conversation scripts

Browse scripts for work, social, family and everyday situations.

### Tone options

Compare different tones like Direct, Warm, Firmer and Softer.

### Example conversations

Read example conversations and try the words aloud before the real moment.

# SocialWise: LLM-Agentic Conversation Therapy for Individuals with Autism Spectrum Disorder to Enhance Communication Skills

Albert Tang

(2025)

###### Abstract.

Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) affects more than 75 million people worldwide. However, scalable support for practicing everyday conversation is scarce: Low-cost activities such as story reading yield limited improvement. At the same time, effective role-play therapy demands expensive, in-person sessions with specialists. SocialWise bridges this gap through a browser-based application that pairs LLM conversational agents with a therapeutic retrieval augmented generation (RAG) knowledge base. Users select a scenario (e.g., ordering food, joining a group), interact by text or voice, and receive instant, structured feedback on tone, engagement, and alternative phrasing. The SocialWise prototype, implemented with Streamlit, LangChain, and ChromaDB, runs on any computer with internet access, and demonstrates how recent advances in LLM can provide evidence-based, on-demand communication coaching for individuals with ASD.

# Virtual Conversation Partner for Adults with Autism

Cyberpsychology Behavior and Social Networking. Published: 2010-07-22. 52 citations.

## Abstract

Autistic Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is notable for severely impaired reciprocal social interaction skills relative to language and intellectual abilities, presenting a major barrier to social integration and vocational success. Evidence-based interventions to address these needs are lacking. We report on the development of a small, prototype conversation simulation to teach conversational skills to adolescents and adults with ASD and average to superior intellectual abilities. We also report on a test of the feasibility and acceptability of the simulation approach with a sample of the target population. The simulation engages the user in a virtual conversation with an on-screen partner whose reactions provide naturalistic feedback geared to the appropriateness of the learner's response choices. The prototype simulation, which provides for up to 12 potentially unique multi-turn conversations, was used over a period of 2 weeks by 16 adolescents and adults who then rated statements about the system on a linear scale of 1 (disagreement) to 5 (high agreement). The participants highly endorsed the majority of positive statements about the quality and credibility of the interaction and the virtual conversation partner.
